intrinsicContainerInlineSize: During the min-content constraint, the cyclic percentage component contributes zero and the absolute 2px minimum remains as each track base.
A minimum contribution 20px across tracks 1-2 subtracts 2px base + 2px gutter + 2px base = 6px, then proposes a 7px planned increase per affected track.
B minimum contribution 40px across tracks 2-3 subtracts the same 6px and proposes 17px per affected track.

Per-track maximum planned increases are [7,17,17]; adding the initial bases gives min-content-constraint track bases [9,19,19]. Tracks plus two gutters occupy 51px; adding the 4px border gives a 55px root border box.
finalIntrinsicColumns: The 51px min-content container size is definite for the final layout pass; calc(10% + 2px) resolves to about 7.1px per minimum track.

After the 4px gutters and resolved minimum bases, the remaining free space is distributed among the three max-content tracks. The resulting equal CSS sizes are quantized to 1/64px as [15.671875,15.671875,15.65625].
A spans columns 1-2 for 33.34375px, so AA A A wraps to line widths [20,30]. B remains 40x10px.
definiteColumns: With a definite 40px content width, each min track is 10% of 40px plus 2px = 6px. The 18px remaining after bases and gutters is distributed equally, giving [12,12,12].
A spans 26px. Its 20px min-content word AA fits, but the remaining 30px phrase A A does not, producing line widths [20,10,10] and a 30px block contribution.
rows: Columns are resolved before rows. For intrinsic width, A contributes 20px and B 10px across two rows: each starts at 2px with a 2px gutter, so A proposes +7px per row and B +2px; maxima give [9,9].
At definite 40px width, A contributes 30px and B 10px; proposals are +12px and +2px per row, yielding [14,14].
derivation.sourceOrder: Reverse scenes change only the DOM child order. The same item-keyed planned-increase maxima, final tracks, line counts, and frames must result.

limitations: Chrome observations are measurements, not the independent normative derivation.
The screenshot is not Spinon runtime evidence and does not establish Android or iOS surface pixels.
The fixed fixture does not close general Grid intrinsic sizing, WPT conformance, glyph raster equality, or the C11.4 parent item.
